messages.subject: Principal Component Analysis with R
parts:
Hi all!

I have a query regarding Principal Component Analysis (PCA) which I am
currently learning from scratch with R -- so apologies if this post is
of a very basic nature.

My query is concerned with comparability between independent PCA
analyses. More concretely, I have carried out PCA analyses on three
independent (comparable) data sets, which I now would like to compare.
Although I have computed variable factor maps for each data set, I
suspect that (i) those will not be enough to reliably compare my
results across data-sets and (ii) comparisons should be done on the
basis of underlying factor loadings and scores. Could anyone confirm
whether that is the case? And if it is, then could anyone recommend of
any studies or book chapters I could use to learn how to compare
reliably independent PCA outputs using R?

Thanks a lot for considering my query, I will welcome any input you
can provide me with!

Best,
Eloiz
